marquee.items: No blades, No wax, No appointments, Aloe vera & allantoin, 8 minutes, For body, legs & arms

steps.heading:
Three steps.
One shower long.
steps.body: No heating up, no touch-up shaving. All you need is the bottle, a damp cloth and eight minutes.
steps.step_1_body: Apply evenly to dry skin until the hairs are covered. Don't rub it in.
steps.step_2_body: The formula dissolves the hair at the surface. Aloe vera keeps your skin calm meanwhile.
steps.step_3_body: Wipe off with a damp cloth, rinse briefly with lukewarm water. Done.

facts.heading: Care that pulls its weight.
facts.fact_1_body: Instead of irritated skin after shaving: allantoin supports regeneration and reduces redness right after use.
facts.fact_2_body: Your skin doesn't dry out the way it does with many hair removal creams. After rinsing, a soft, cared-for film remains.
facts.fact_3_body: Cosmetic Product Safety Report under EU regulation 1223/2009. Made and tested in the EU, vegan and cruelty-free.

faq.heading: Still have questions?
faq.body_html: Write to us at hallo@myhaut.de – we usually reply the same working day.
faq.q_1: Which body areas is the spray suitable for?
faq.a_1: Legs, arms, underarms, chest and back. Do not use on the face, the intimate area or irritated skin.
faq.q_2: How long does the skin stay smooth?
faq.a_2: Because the hair is dissolved below the skin's surface, it takes most people five to seven days before anything grows back – noticeably longer than after shaving. And it comes back soft, not stubbly.
faq.q_3: Is it suitable for sensitive skin?
faq.a_3: Aloe vera and allantoin are in the formula for exactly that reason. Still, do a patch test on a small area of your inner elbow 24 hours in advance.
faq.q_4: Does the spray smell like other hair removal creams?
faq.a_4: No. The formula works without the typical harsh smell – you get a light, neutral scent.
faq.q_5: What if it doesn't work for me?
faq.a_5: Send us a message within 30 days and you'll get the full purchase price back – even with an opened bottle.
